mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_repo (repo_name, repo_type, source_path, branch, app_name, git_user, git_token, status, file_count, total_size) VALUES (#{repoName}, #{repoType}, #{sourcePath}, #{branch}, #{appName}, #{gitUser}, #{gitToken}, 'importing', 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE source_repo SET app_name = #{appName} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_repo SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_repo SET status = 'ready', file_count = #{fileCount}, total_size = #{totalSize} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_repo SET branch = #{branch} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, repo_name, repo_type, source_path, branch, app_name, git_user, status, file_count, total_size, error_msg, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , git_token FROM source_repo WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM source_repo WHERE repo_name = #{repoName} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM source_repo ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
